hints.title: Dual Direction Match Flags
hints.text: Identify grid cells participating in a horizontal occurrence of the pattern and cells in a vertical occurrence.

hints.title: Row and Column Substring Scanning
hints.text: Scan every row horizontally and every column vertically to mark covered coordinate cells.

hints.title: Intersection Counting
hints.text: Count the number of cells (i, j) that are marked in both directions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: M: number of rows in grid

complexity.notes: Direct substring checks mark overlapping grid coverage flags.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting full grid backtracking does redundant work compared to linear row/column scans.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boolean matrices store match coverage for direct intersection counting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track cell participation in both horizontal and vertical string occurrences.
